description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for managing followers within the application. It includes a command class, a validator, and a request handler to process the deletion of a follower relationship based on a username.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a follower by username.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command ensuring the Username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of a follower relationship and returns the profile envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to remove a follower from the context and reads the profile.
